title: The Walls of Jericho
reflectionQuestion: What do you think it was like to march around those great walls so quietly, day after day, waiting?
kidSafetyNotes: Joshua 6 adapted for ages 4-7 (Adam 2026-06-15): conquest/killing OMITTED entirely. Reframed from 'God has given us the city' / 'walked into the city' (dispossession) to Joshua shouting 'God is with us!' + a wonder ending ('all the things God could do'). Theme = TRUSTING God before you see anything happen (the quiet marching, the waiting). 'God is with us!' ties to the not-alone spine (faithful: the ark/God's presence is carried around Jericho). One image: the walls tumbling flat. Texture: kinetic/exterior/sound (marching, trumpets, shout, crash).
